# Junos switching protection

- `switching_bpdu.out` is an excerpt of the Juniper QFX CLI reference example “Disabled by bpdu-control”. The interface selector was adapted to match the accompanying real interface-details capture. https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/software/junos/cli-reference/topics/ref/command/show-ethernet-switching-interfaces-qfx-series.html
- `switching_stp.out` is an excerpt of Juniper's *Day One: Exploring the Junos CLI*, chapter 2, showing the alternate blocking column. The interface selector was adapted in the same way. https://www.juniper.net/documentation/en_US/day-one-books/ExploreJunosCLI_2ndEd.pdf
